body_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) formally welcomed Ms. Marites M. Sierra as the first Director I of the AFP Civilian Human Resources (CHR) during an oath-taking ceremony held here. The ceremony was presided over by Lieutenant General Edmundo G. Peralta PA, The Deputy Chief of Staff, AFP representing AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete PA.

Director Sierra brings nearly 25 years of government service to her new leadership role, underscoring the AFP’s commitment to strengthening its CHR management. Her appointment reflects the AFP’s recognition that CHRs are not merely an administrative function, but a critical leadership responsibility that contributes directly to organizational effectiveness, professionalism, and mission readiness.

As the first Director I to lead AFP CHRs, Director Sierra assumes a significant responsibility in shaping a more responsive, professional, and people-centered civilian workforce. The strength of the AFP is not measured solely by those in uniform, but also by the dedicated civilian professionals whose expertise, commitment, and service help sustain the institution and keep the organization mission-ready.

Photos by SSg Ambay PA / PAOAFP
